instruction: Cinematic low-angle medium shot of an outdoor concrete wall under a clear blue sky. On the left, the boy in the tie-dye shirt (R2) stands upright on the wall, arms extended slightly for balance, looking down. On the right, the boy in the pink striped shirt (R1) stands in profile, looking downward. Bright, direct daylight casts soft shadows against the vibrant blue sky.
